_about.what: Text versions of the 16 HCRC Map Task maps: landmark positions and the giver's route.
_about.coordinates: x = 0 (west/left edge) to 65 (east/right edge); y = 0 (north/top edge) to 90 (south/bottom edge); 1 unit = 10 px of the corpus GIF maps (651 x 900).
_about.name: landmark id as in the corpus file maptask-landmarks.xml
_about.label: the text written on the map (what the speakers saw), when it differs from name
_about.route: giver map only: the drawn route from START to FINISH as a polyline of (x, y) points
_about.source: Transcribed from the corpus map images (maps.tar.gz) and checked by overlaying each transcription on its image. HCRC Map Task Corpus, Human Communication Research Centre, Universities of Edinburgh and Glasgow, CC BY 4.0, https://groups.inf.ed.ac.uk/maptask/
